title: IELTS Academic — full preparation
content:
Four skills, twice-weekly classes, and four full mocks under timed conditions. Suitable for students starting from band 5.5 and targeting 6.5 or 7.

Classes run at our Dhanmondi office in groups of no more than eight. A diagnostic mock at enrolment sets the starting band; progress is re-measured every fortnight so you know whether you are on track for your target before you book the real test.

title: IELTS — speaking and writing intensive
content:
For students whose reading and listening are already where they need to be. One-to-one speaking practice and weekly written feedback on Task 1 and Task 2.

Classes run at our Dhanmondi office in groups of no more than eight. A diagnostic mock at enrolment sets the starting band; progress is re-measured every fortnight so you know whether you are on track for your target before you book the real test.
